subject: [hw] K01 -> IK: /dev/redwood-jpeg integration lines + compile-check result
body:
IK: gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_jpegdev.inc and kern/test_k01/** are in place.

sweet_touch.c, after #include "nord2_hwcodec.inc":
  #include "nord2_jpegdev.inc"   /* K01: /dev/redwood-jpeg */
and in nord2_input_init() after the existing starts:
  nord2_jpegdev_start();     /* K01: /dev/redwood-jpeg */

Include order once K02 lands: nord2_hwcodec.inc, nord2_vcodec.inc, nord2_jpegdev.inc. K02 expects its file before mine; mine only calls the model n2j_* functions and (if K02 registers it) n2jd_share_ven. If you copy my .inc into kernel/b/bsd/dev, its __has_include fallback ../../../../include/redwood_jpeg.h finds gpu/hwcodec/include; if it stays in kern/bsd/dev, ../../../include does. Both verified with clang -E. No extra -I is required for the header, but -Igpu/hwcodec/include also works.

Kernel compile check I ran (not a claim about your 0299): copied kernel/b/bsd/dev/sweet_touch.c to /tmp, added the two lines, symlinked nord2_hwcodec.inc/nord2_autotest.inc/nord2_jpegdev.inc, then
  python3 gpu/tools/xnu_staged_compile.py /tmp/.../sweet_touch.c --out ... --extra=-Igpu/hwcodec/include --extra=-I/tmp/... --extra=-I<stage>/bsd/dev --extra=-I<stage>/bsd
-> exit 0, 0 errors/warnings with -Wall -Wextra -Werror, object 1178480 bytes.

Host: bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K01 PASS 732/732 (violations 0) under ASan+UBSan, plain -O2 and TSan. The node is created 0666 at nord2_input_init; no register is touched at boot. Symbols added to the TU: nord2_jpegdev_start (static, unused-attribute so a build without the call still links), n2jd_share_ven (global, for K02), everything else static n2jd_*/n2jd_.
